Title: Ireland – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – 9096 Qualification System for Civil Engineering Works €50k to €1m
Procedure title: 9096 Qualification System for Civil Engineering Works €50k to €1m
Description: Iarnród Éireann (IÉ) is seeking expressions of interest from suitably qualified applicants to establish a Qualification System for Civil Engineering associated with upgrading of the railway infrastructure and other related works that Iarnród Eireann may undertake directly or on behalf of Bus Eireann, Dublin Bus or CIE on their properties. The extent and details of these works will vary from location to location.
